# RAVN UI - SaaS Core Design System
Minimal, premium, CDN-first UI library built for high-performance SaaS interfaces. Designed for clarity, scale, and elite aesthetics.

## Overview
RAVN UI provides a strict, production-grade component set with zero framework overhead. It is built on a modular CSS architecture and a robust design token system.

- **Technology**: Vanilla CSS + JS (CDN-First)
- **Size**: < 15KB (Uncompressed), ~7KB (Gzipped)
- **Dependencies**: 0
- **Philosophy**: Neutral palettes, high-end typography (Inter), zero emojis.

## Installation & Setup
### CDN Usage (Recommended)
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/@ravn-ui/core/dist/ui.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/@ravn-ui/core/dist/themes.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/@ravn-ui/core/dist/ui.js"></script>
```

### Package Manager
```bash
bun add @ravn-ui/core
# or
npm install @ravn-ui/core
```

## Design Tokens (CSS Variables)
RAVN UI is driven by a 4px base spacing scale and a semantic color palette.
- **Colors**: `--background`, `--foreground`, `--primary`, `--muted`, `--border`, `--success`, `--warning`, `--error`.
- **Spacing**: `--space-1` (0.25rem/4px) to `--space-12` (3rem/48px).
- **Radius**: `--radius` (0.375rem).

## Component Library
### Buttons
Variants: `.btn-primary`, `.btn-outline`, `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-sm`.
```html
<button class="btn btn-primary">Elite Action</button>
```

### Cards
Structured for data density.
```html
<div class="card">
  <div class="card-header"><h3>Title</h3><small>Subtitle</small></div>
  <div class="card-content">Main metrics or data.</div>
  <div class="card-footer"><button class="btn btn-sm">Details</button></div>
</div>
```

### Modals & Interactivity
Toggle via `data-modal-target="id"` or programmatically.
```html
<div id="m1" class="modal">
  <div class="modal-backdrop"></div>
  <div class="modal-content">
    <h3>Header</h3>
    <button data-modal-close>Close</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Dashboard Patterns
- **Sidebar**: Vertical navigation with `.sidebar-item`.
- **Breadcrumbs**: Hierarchical paths with `.breadcrumb-item`.
- **Metric Trends**: `.trend-up` and `.trend-down` status indicators.
- **Progress**: `.progress` and `.progress-bar`.

## Theming System
Apply themes via `data-theme` on the `html` tag.
- **Available Themes**: `light`, `dark`, `claude`, `midnight`, `supabase`, `linear`, `zinc`, `forest`, `indigo`, `retro`, `pixel-craft`, `rose-pine`, `nord`.
- **Auto-Detection**: Library respects `prefers-color-scheme` if no theme is hardcoded.

## JavaScript API (window.RAVN)
- `RAVN.setTheme(string)`: Persists theme selection to localStorage.
- `RAVN.showToast(string)`: Triggers a minimal system toast.
- `RAVN.modal(id, action)`: Programmatic control for modals.
- `RAVN.copy(text, message)`: Clipboard utility with success feedback.

## Documentation
Full documentation available at: https://ravn-ui.vercel.app/
Modular documentation sources: `/docs/components/*.html`
